description:
Source: https://github.com/www-zaq-ai/zaq/issues/834

Approved product/design decisions from this planning session:
- Conversations owns structured per-message author/timestamp/content projection; People owns directory lookup. Resolve current directory name on preparation/load, including protected merge aliases. Do not refresh names already loaded into agent state.
- Missing/deleted Person or blank name: Unknown author. Assistant: known agent name or Assistant. Preserve native system/tool roles and tool identity. Never infer message authorship from conversation owner, requester, execution recipient, or unverified tool parameters. Preserve existing source author IDs independently.
- Persisted Message.provider_sent_at is authoritative. If absent, use Message.inserted_at and explicitly label it Recorded at. For non-persisted input use a trusted source timestamp only; otherwise omit timestamp. Never generate message time with DateTime.utc_now() at processing/queue-consumption time.
- Presentation carries author, timestamp value/provenance, and content separately. Render a compact text header, not a JSON body: Author: "Alice Martin" [person:42] followed by Sent at: <formatted provider time> OR Recorded at: <formatted insertion time>, then Message: and unchanged body. Omit absent timestamp/identity fields; escape the author name onto one line. Reuse DateUtils.format_ts/1.
- Agent.InputPrompt owns the shared renderer. Render once when supplying input/history to Jido. Persisted content and raw admission comparisons remain untouched. Preserve attachments and native tool-call structure. Existing Jido identity/execution refs stay; do not add author/time refs, rename invalidation, runtime refresh, or RequestTransformer rendering logic.
- Factory composes the explanatory instruction using its existing runtime_system_prompt/configuration and ensure_system_prompt -> Jido.AI.set_system_prompt flow. Do not introduce another prompt-update mechanism.
- accounts.fetch_history forwards attribution in both nested and flat message representations; it performs no Person resolution. Retrieval.ask is excluded from attribution implementation and documented deprecated, without migrating its existing callers.

Workflow: Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, applicable Agent/Engine service guides. Read module responsibility docs before edits. Add tests before implementing each behavior. Existing-test behavior changes require separately recorded explicit approval; approval of this plan is not that approval. Only external API boundaries may be mocked; exercise real domain/database paths. No browser/UI change is planned: prefer provider-boundary integration tests over new browser E2E. Reassess and obtain the required gate if scope changes. No new agent tool or workflow Action exposure is authorized.

Implementation is not complete. This epic owns the approved contract and children own test-first delivery. Refactor PR #835 was confirmed merged during audit. Use a linear delivery DAG to keep reviews and test-contract approval explicit; no diamond dependencies. Validation, review, coverage and authorized landing remain required.
title: [#834] Consistent message author attribution and source timestamps
